Consultation Paper on review of framework for equity derivatives expiry
URL: https://example.org/cp-derivatives-expiry

SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - NOT A REAL REGULATOR DOCUMENT.

1. Background
The regulator has observed that 59% of index options turnover occurs in same-day-expiry contracts.

2. Proposal
It is proposed that the minimum contract value for index derivatives be reviewed from Rs 15 lakh.
It is proposed that an additional margin of 2% be levied on short options on expiry day.

3. Public comments
Comments may be submitted by 15 October 2026.
